prerequisites: (492) Materials Science: Ferrous materials: properties and applications.
(495) Strength of Materials: Stresses and deformations, Linear elastic constitutive equations, Tension and compression, Torsion, Bending, Buckling.

learning_outcomes.text: Apply the theory of plates and shells to the calculation of surface elements (tank walls, walls, roofs)
Know the constructive arrangement of the different elements that make up an industrial construction
Dimension the most common structural typologies in industrial construction
Apply the general regulations on structures and building contained in the Technical Building Code.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1.- Introduction to structural design. Structural typologies, in general. Structural safety. Load Hypotheses.
Topic 6.- Matrix calculation of structures. Stiffness method.
Practices: Calculation of planar reticular structures. Practical cases using 3D structural software tools.
assessment_rules: To pass the subject, a minimum of 40% must be obtained in the exam. If this critical evaluation criterion is not met, the total grade for the subject will be FAIL, with the resulting grade from the sum of the qualifications obtained in all evaluation systems, truncated to a maximum of 4.5 points. Written tests are recoverable. For part-time students, non-recoverable evaluation activities will be substituted by equivalent ones provided the reason for their non-completion is the same for which the University granted them part-time student status.
